strings.ピコピコピーン！！\nすでに意識しているかもしれませんが、大切な事なので\n属性:
Piko-piko-piin!!
You may already be aware, but this is important,
so let me explain attributes, types, roles, and aptitudes!
strings.キャラクターはそれぞれ属性を持っており、\n属性によって有利不利が存在します！:
Every character has an attribute,
and attributes have advantages and disadvantages!
strings.まずは属性のボタンを押してみて下さい！: First, try pressing the Attribute button!
strings.キャラクターの属性がどの属性に有利かは\nこちらの表を確認して、編成を組むように:
To see which attributes a character is strong against,
check this table and build your formation accordingly!
strings.物理タイプはアタッカーやタンクの役割が多い傾向で\n前衛を得意とするキャラクター:
Physical types tend to fill attacker and tank roles,
and many of them excel in the vanguard!
strings.ENタイプはENアタッカーやサポート、コントロールの役割が多く\n後衛を得意とす:
EN types often fill EN attacker, support, and control roles,
and many of them excel in the rearguard!
strings.敏捷タイプはENタイプと違って\n物理アタッカー、サポートやコントロールの役割が:
Agile types, unlike EN types,
more often fill physical attacker, support, and control roles,
and many excel as both vanguard and rearguard!
strings.<size=40>物理タイプ</size>\n物理アタッカーやタンクの役割が多く:
<size=40>Physical Type</size>
Often fills physical attacker and tank roles,
and tends to have position aptitude for the vanguard.
strings.<size=40>ENタイプ</size>\nENアタッカーやサポート、\nコン:
<size=40>EN Type</size>
Often fills EN attacker, support,
and control roles,
and tends to have position aptitude for the rearguard.
strings.<size=40>敏捷タイプ</size>\n物理アタッカーやサポート、\nコン:
<size=40>Agile Type</size>
Often fills physical attacker and support,
and control roles,
and tends to have position aptitude for both vanguard and rearguard.
strings.タイプはあくまで傾向なので、\n実際にロールとポジション適性を確認してみましょう:
Type is only a tendency, so
let's check the actual roles and position aptitudes!
strings.物理アタッカーは物理攻撃でダメージを出す事を得意としてます！\n攻撃は最大の防御:
Physical attackers excel at dealing damage with physical attacks!
They say attack is the best defence, so work them into your formation!
strings.ENアタッカーはEN攻撃でダメージを出す事を得意としてます！\n物理アタッカーと:
EN attackers excel at dealing damage with EN attacks!
Pairing them with a physical attacker in front and rear
for a damage-focused setup is another good plan!!
strings.つづいてタンクはHPが多かったり防御が高かったりするので\n前衛に配置して敵から:
Next, tanks have lots of HP and high defence,
so they excel at holding the vanguard and shielding allies from enemy attacks!
You always want one in your formation.
strings.サポートは味方の強化や回復を得意としているので\n編成に合わせて必要なサポートを:
Supports excel at buffing and healing allies,
so pick the support your formation needs!
strings.コントロールは変わって敵に状態異常や妨害などを行います！\n火力だけで突破が難し:
Controls, on the other hand, inflict status ailments and interference on enemies!
They are perfect for technical fights that raw damage cannot break through!
strings.<size=40>物理アタッカー</size>\n物理攻撃を扱いダメージを出すこ:
<size=40>Physical Attacker</size>
A role specialising in physical attacks and dealing damage
strings.<size=40>ENアタッカー</size>\nEN攻撃を扱いダメージを出すこ:
<size=40>EN Attacker</size>
A role specialising in EN attacks and dealing damage
strings.<size=40>タンク</size>\n高い耐久力で攻撃を引き受け、味方を守る:
<size=40>Tank</size>
A role specialising in taking hits with high durability and protecting allies
strings.<size=40>サポート</size>\n味方の強化や回復などを行う、支援に特:
<size=40>Support</size>
A role specialising in assisting allies with buffs and healing
strings.<size=40>コントロール</size>\n状態異常や妨害などを行う、行動阻:
<size=40>Control</size>
A role specialising in hindering enemies with status ailments and interference
strings.一気に説明しちゃいましたけど、いつでも確認出来るので\n忘れちゃった時はまた見に:
That was a lot at once, but you can check it any time,
so come back whenever you forget!
strings.キャラクターによっては不得意なポジションがあるので\n編成で配置を決めるときは少:
Some characters have positions they are bad at,
so be a little careful when deciding placements in your formation!
strings.これで属性・タイプ・ロール、適性については以上になります！\nキャラクター達を上:
That covers attributes, types, roles, and aptitudes!
Build your characters well and aim for the strongest unit!
And leave anything else to me!
strings.前後列のどちらに配置しても\nステータスの変動がない:
No stat change wherever
they are placed in the front or rear

strings.<line-height=2.000em>隙間時間を使って様々なアイテムを獲得し: <line-height=2.000em>Use your spare time to earn all kinds of items.\nDon't forget to take part every day!
strings.<line-height=2.000em>学園内の生徒たちと共に挑む一大作戦。\: <line-height=2.000em>A grand operation alongside the Academy's students.\nTeam up with commanders from every world to bring down boss after boss!
strings.ピコピコーン！ マスター！ 準備はできていますか！？\nイザナミを『倒す』ために:
Piko-piko-n! Master! Are you ready!?
To "defeat" Izanami, we would like to strike the "Yatagarasu" itself, but...
strings.まずはマスドライバーを襲撃する『天津甕星』の攻撃を防ぐことからです！\nどの『天:
First, we need to stop the attacks of the "Amatsu Mikaboshi" that are raiding the mass driver!
Which "Amatsu Mikaboshi" to target is up to you, Master!
strings.選んだ『天津甕星』と戦っている時は、他の『天津甕星』と戦えませんのでご注意を！\:
Note that while fighting a chosen "Amatsu Mikaboshi" you cannot fight the others!
Once a set period passes and the phase changes, you will be able to fight the others again!
strings.それではマスター！ イザナミを倒すために……\n『天津甕星』へと挑んでいきましょ:
Now then, Master! In order to defeat Izanami...
let's take on the "Amatsu Mikaboshi"!
